info.title: Aurelia Hall School API
info.description: Sample build. Errors use one envelope: `{ error: { code, message, details } }`. Admin endpoints need a staff session and the permission named on each; money is integer paise.

get.summary: Cursor-paginated list; filter with ?stage=&class=&year=&q=, sort with ?sort=&dir=
Application with documents and timeline

patch.summary: Move stage (validated state machine; decisions need applications:decide)

get.summary: Offer letter PDF (staff)
Cursor-paginated, newest first. `from`/`to` are IST dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Rows carry a redacted list of changed fields, never the raw before/after JSON
The filtered log as CSV (same filters as the list). Audit-logged as `audit.export`
The draft as an .mdx file for content/blog
The dues view as CSV (formula-safe), audit-logged

post.summary: Runs the adapter's self-test (email goes to the caller's own address; whatsapp and sms need `{ "phone": "+91 …" }`). Returns `{ ok, message, ms }`; a failed test is a 200 with ok false

get.summary: Each adapter's mode (MOCK / LIVE / OFF), whether its variables are set (names only, never values) and the last runs of every scheduled job
Cursor-paginated list; same filters as the CRM inbox

post.summary: Staff create a lead from a walk-in or phone call (no captcha)

get.summary: Lead with activities, bookings and reminders

patch.summary: Status, assignment, follow-up date. Assignment needs leads:assign

get.summary: CSV export (elevated permission, audit-logged)
Sent/failed messages (bodies omitted)
The privacy request queue

patch.summary: `{ status: "DONE" | "REJECTED", notes }` closes an open request. Audit-logged

get.summary: Everything held about the subject of an EXPORT request, as a JSON download. Medical records, internal notes and credentials are never included. Each download is audit-logged as `privacy.bundle`
A realistic bank statement built from recent offline payments (demo aid)
The same tables as the report page. Needs reports:export; every download is audit-logged with its filter
Role-aware global search over students, leads and applications
The school profile (saved settings over the static defaults)

put.summary: Replaces the school profile. Money is integer paise

get.summary: Cursor-paginated, submitted applications only (drafts are never listed). Rows omit the application form itself; fetch /api/admin/staff-applications/[id] for that
The whole application with its scorecard and notes

patch.summary: `status` (+ `reason`, required for REJECTED), `scorecard` (five ratings 1–5 and an optional `comment`; the total becomes `score`) and/or `note`. Applied in that order

get.summary: The application as a PDF. Needs careers:read; each download is audit-logged
CR80 ID card
The filtered directory as CSV. Contact details only; never medical data. Exports are a SENSITIVE action and audit-logged with the filter used
Upcoming slots with bookings

post.summary: Create slots: { dates: ["2026-10-12"], times: ["09:30"], capacity: 6, label }

get.summary: Staff accounts (parents and applicants are not listed)

post.summary: Invites a staff member: creates the account and emails a sign-in link

patch.summary: `{ role, reason }` changes a staff role; `{ active, reason }` switches access on or off

get.summary: Every vacancy with its application counts

post.summary: Create a vacancy. `requirements` is an array of strings (or one per line), `closesAt` is a calendar date (yyyy-mm-dd, end of that day in IST). Validated in the service

get.summary: One vacancy with its application counts

patch.summary: Any subset of the vacancy fields, including `status` to close or reopen

delete.summary: Only while the vacancy has no applications

get.summary: The family's own offer letter
Issues an image challenge (image provider) or tells the client which widget to render
Runs a scheduled job (the method Vercel Cron uses). Needs the cron secret as a bearer token

post.summary: Runs a scheduled job from any other scheduler. Needs the cron secret as a bearer token

get.summary: Latest 50 outbox messages as JSON (dev/demo only), so you can click mock magic links. Each item links to /api/dev/outbox/[id] which renders the email HTML
Renders one mock email (dev/demo only). Sandboxed via CSP
Upcoming public events (Open Mornings, talks, concerts)
Serves a stored file for a signed, short-lived download link (issued after an access check)
The fee invoice PDF for finance staff or the pupil's guardians

post.summary: Enquiry or campus-tour booking from any public placement. Zod validation · honeypot · captcha · 5 requests / 10 min / IP · double-submit protection

get.summary: OpenAPI 3.1 description of this API (generated from the route handlers)

post.summary: A guardian tops up a boarder's pocket money through the gateway
Create a gateway order for an invoice, an instalment, or a custom amount

get.summary: Minimal order status for the return page poller (no personal data)

post.summary: Client-return verification (order id, payment id, signature)
Signed gateway webhooks. Reads the RAW body (signatures are over raw bytes), verifies the signature, and applies events idempotently. Always 2xx for duplicates so gateways stop retrying
post.description: Called by the payment gateway. The body is verified against the provider's signature header.

get.summary: PDF for finance staff, the pupil's guardians, or the paying applicant

post.summary: Create a draft application from step 1 (child). Returns { id, ref, draftToken }

patch.summary: Save a later step (parents, boarding, declaration) of the draft; needs the draft token

get.summary: Current document status for the application

post.summary: Returns a signed upload target for one document slot
Validates the draft is complete and creates the registration-fee order

get.summary: The whole public content index (small), searched client-side on /search

post.summary: Save one step of the public staff application, or submit it. - First save (no `id`, step 1): creates the draft; the response carries `resumeToken` once. - Later saves and submit need `id` + `token`; each step is validated with the same schemas as the form. - Submit validates every step (422 INCOMPLETE with per-step issues) and checks the captcha. - The honeypot (`website`) silently succeeds

get.summary: The saved draft (or just the status once submitted)

post.summary: Signed upload target for one certificate (header x-resume-token). The browser PUTs the file to the returned URL and keeps the returned `key` in its education row
Called by the browser after it uploaded straight to the object store (S3). The server fetches the file back, checks its size and magic bytes and runs the scan hook; a bad file is deleted

put.summary: Receiver for the local storage adapter's signed upload URLs
